blocks.text: Reading layout after each style change can make the browser repeatedly calculate positions. Group reads and then writes when possible.

Use a local test page and browser developer tools. Code samples show a page choice or a measurement. Compare before and after under the same conditions; exact timings depend on the device and network.

blocks.title: Avoid repeating layout work

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `querySelectorAll` returns the current matching elements. Its list is a snapshot rather than a live record of later matches.
`getBoundingClientRect` reads the displayed geometry of an element. Group layout reads before writes in a measured hot loop.

blocks.text: The code reads all widths first, then applies the new heights.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not assume every DOM read is expensive. Measure the real loop before making complicated changes.
